title: Connections
description: Import selected local files into local search. Sources are read-only and never contact remote services. Disconnecting removes their cached content.
name: Name
localLimits: UTF-8 .txt and Markdown files only. Folders include up to 50 files, three subfolder levels and 1 MB total. Symbolic links are excluded.
calendarLimits: Import up to 200 events from a local ICS file. Dates retain their calendar timezone notation. Recurrences are not expanded. This does not connect a calendar account.
stale: Showing cached content from the last successful sync.
remoteDisabled: This remote connection is disabled in the local-only workspace. Previously cached content remains available locally until you disconnect.
